topic: Domain and Range of Trigonometric Functions
title: Never Above 1! Domain and Range Explained Simply | PUC Maths Class 11
description:
Spin a bicycle wheel as fast as you like: the tyre valve never rises more than one radius above the hub, and never sinks more than one radius below it. Aarav checks it with a measuring tape. In this animated lesson for PUC and Class 11 Maths (NCERT Chapter 3, Trigonometric Functions) we find the domain and range of all six trigonometric functions.

You will watch P go round the unit circle twice while the graph of y = sin x draws live and a range meter fills up to exactly 1 and down to exactly -1, prove -1 <= sin x <= 1 in four steps, see tan x shoot up as x creeps to 90 degrees and break where cos x = 0, and build one table for sin, cos, tan, cot, sec and cosec. Two pause-and-think questions, a worked example (the range of 3 + 2 sin x with a live graph), the exam trap about the range of sec x, an original JEE Main pattern question with a full solution, a recap card and three questions to check yourself.

Made for PUC (Karnataka), CBSE Class 11 and JEE Main students.

In this video:
0:00 How high can the tyre valve go?
0:28 Domain and range: two words
0:38 Live: two turns, sin x stays between -1 and 1
0:59 Proof in four steps
1:35 Tangent shoots up near 90 degrees
2:12 All six functions in one table
2:34 Sine vs tangent: side by side
3:28 Worked example: range of 3 + 2 sin x
3:56 Exam trap: the range of sec x
4:14 Where it is asked
4:22 Practice question (JEE Main pattern)
4:55 Recap and three questions to answer

Next episode (Ep 30): Graphs of Sine, Cosine and Tangent. Trace the valve's height over time and a wave appears.
